comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A few more unlisted Sundries trading boost items:

Star Sapphire Hair Dressing -- +2 accessory; sold in Istanbul's item shop, but investment (and thus being a member of the Ottoman Empire) is required.

Lace Brim -- +1 female-only headgear; produced at Manchester or an Industrial Revolution City's Loom.

Western Bonnet -- +1 female only headgear. There's actually two versions of this; one is a possible weekly reward for Large Gold Nugget mining (valued at 14,000 points nugget points) and gives +1 Metal trading as well, while the second is only +1 Sundries trading and is produced through a sewing book given for completing the North American Pioneer Clothes MA.

Kichka -- +1 female-only headgear; produced with R11 Sewing in St. Petersburg with Embroidery thread x15 and Felt x30 via "Street Daughter" NPC near the bank (does not seem to be Chrono-specific).

There are some other items, but they don't seem to be in GAMA yet. Cheers, all.
